But now it's boots-on-ground, the final stretch before my internship.
This is it: the month that decides whether I made it or break it.

Everyone's counting down to freedom. While I gaze upon my tasks, calories, unread emails, and nights without sleep.
Everything's fragile. Final (recursive) projects, last-minute submissions, more co-curricular activities, and the team that might let me do nothing or abandon me.

reasons:

description:
Routine of a Presoft employee:
Wake up, drive to work, clock in, work, clock out, have lunch, clock in, continue work, clock out, suffer in jam, go home, sleep, and repeat.

Presoft continues its quiet indoctrination: polish the edges, fit the mold, adapt or fade.
But I'm still here. Still learning what it means to be an actual member of society, not just for university or ITP — but for someone else's stakes.
I see now — this isn't about brilliance. It's about showing up, again and again, without breaking.

The Saturdays still sting.
The pace still burns.
The jam still kills.
But I'm not flinching anymore.

Maybe that's what growth looks like — not louder, just steadier.
One more month.

title: Hold it in. 1 more month.
reasons:
Deepavali: 20/10,
    WFH: 28/10,
    Mini break post internship: 29/10 - 2/11
description:
One final rush, hold it in, one more month. The final stretch at Presoft:
These corridors feel different now. Same walls, same faces, but I move through them differently.

These months of adaptation have left their mark — not just in scars, but in skills.
The indoctrination worked, I suppose. I've learned to fit without breaking, to bend without folding.
And maybe that's the real victory — becoming malleable without becoming someone else.

The traffic still stretches endlessly.
The deadlines still loom without mercy.
The exhaustion still weighs heavy.
But I've built something here that I'll carry forward.

As this chapter closes, I realize growth isn't about comfort — it's about capacity.
Not how much you enjoy the climb, but how much higher you can reach after.

description:
The year's final month arrives like a weight I can't set down.
FYP deadlines loom like shadows, new subjects press against the walls of my attention, and the chaos refuses to pause with random groupmates.
Each day folds into the next, a tangle of code, readings, and chores, and I chase it all knowing that missing a single beat could ripple across everything, akin the Butterfly Effect.

The apartment smells faintly of Ikea and fungus, reminders that life continues while I sprint through a maze of tasks.
Nights stretch long and thin; sleep is a currency I spend reluctantly, only to find the next day demanding repayment with interest, or face shutting down.
Yet somehow, amid the fatigue, there's a quiet pulse of accomplishment — small victories stacked against a backdrop of relentless work.

This month is not about ease. It's about endurance, about finishing the year not in comfort but in motion.
If 2025 (and Presoft) taught me anything, it's that growth isn't measured in peace, but in persistence.
So I push forward, one task, one deadline, one exhausted breath at a time. Using up all the skills learnt thus far.
The end is near, but I'm still standing — still learning, still adapting, still becoming.
